_doc.purpose: Maps a USD economic indicator to how an ABOVE-forecast actual (a BEAT) moves the US dollar. predicted_currency_direction = polarity * sign(predicted_surprise). MATCH or polarity 0 => SKIP.
_doc.polarity: +1 = higher actual is USD-bullish; -1 = higher actual is USD-bearish; 0 = direction ambiguous intraday -> never trade
_doc.keyed_by: TradingView 'indicator' field (exact), with title as fallback
_doc.assumption_note: Inflation prints are treated as USD-bullish on a beat via the hawkish-Fed channel, which is the usual immediate reaction but not universal (stagflation regimes can invert it). Documented, not hidden.

Core Inflation Rate MoM.note: hot core CPI MoM = hawkish = bullish

Core PCE Price Index MoM.note: Fed's preferred gauge hot = hawkish = bullish

Balance of Trade.note: trade balance direction on USD is ambiguous intraday -> skip
